scope: 21 exact physical bone Prayer-resource subtype corrections; no tags or secondary-role additions.
reviewRecord: Root read all33 exact own bone definitions/states and material contexts, with complete source followups for nine competing-use articles; independent review caught missing Wolf/greegree contexts and confirms these21 Prayer primary targets. Wolf, seven monkey/greegree variants, two marinated quest states and two Construction training bones remain outside this policy. Superior raw bones provide Prayer directly; crushed-product Herblore mechanics are not transferred.

cases.title: Bones
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Bones detail.png|left|120x120px]]
'''Bones''' are the [[remains]] of most [[monsters|creatures]] with an animalistic or humanoid appearance.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
Bones give 4.5 [[Prayer]] experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 13.5 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
* 13.5 XP when using the [[sacred bone burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 15.7 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit or at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]]. The Temple additionally has a 50% chance to not deplete the bones; effectively doubling the XP to 31.4 per bone.
* 18 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[bonemeal]].
* 20 XP when [[blessed bones|blessed]], broken down into [[blessed bone shards]] and offered at the [[libation bowl]] with [[jug of blessed wine]], or 24 XP when offered with a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]]. [[Virilis]] outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.

25 regular bones are used in the [[Demon Slayer]] [[quest]].

[[File:Bones mouse hole.png|thumb|170px|Bones dropped by [[mouse|mice]] during [[Grim Tales]].]]
*Burying normal bones from level 1 to 99 [[Prayer]] would require 2,896,541 bones at a cost of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Bones|2896541}}|c}} and over 40 days of continuous burying.
* During [[Grim Tales]], the relatively large [[mouse|mice]] in the [[mouse hole]] drop relatively large bones when killed.
*When a monster dies and their bones despawn, they are taken to the Graveyard room of the [[Mage Training Arena]] to be converted to either [[bananas]] or [[peaches]].
cases.rationale: Own physical bone has direct repeated Prayer burial/offering function; use the existing prayer-resource subtype while retaining Resources tab and every existing tag. '''Burnt bones''' are one of the few [[Remains|bones]] that [[free players]] can bury to train [[Prayer]], with the others being [[bones|normal bones]], [[big bones]], and [[monkey bones]]. They can be found in the [[Kebos Battlefront]], the [[Lizardman Canyon]], the [[Dragon Nest]], and various locations in the [[Wilderness]].

Burnt bones give 4.5 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 13.5 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
* 13.5 XP when offered at the [[Sacred Bone Burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 15.7 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit or at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]].
* 18 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[burnt bonemeal]].

It is not recommended to train Prayer with burnt bones, as they are no different from regular [[bones]], which are much easier to obtain. Additionally, unlike regular bones, they cannot be blessed on the [[exposed altar]].

cases.title: Big bones
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Big bones detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Big bones''' are a bigger variant of [[bones]]. They are always dropped by certain large monsters including [[giants]], [[ogre]]s, [[troll]]s, [[Cyclops|cyclopes]], and the [[lizard]]s in the Kharidian Desert just north of [[Nardah]]. A few spawns of big bones can also be found in the [[Bone Yard]] in the Wilderness, and in the area around the [[Colossal Wyrm Remains]] located in [[Varlamore|Varlamore's]] [[Avium Savannah]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
Big bones give 15 [[Prayer]] experience when buried. As a member, this can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 45 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
*45 XP when offered at the [[sacred bone burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 52.5 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit.
* 60 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[big bonemeal]].
* 60 XP when [[Blessed big bones|blessed]] and broken down into [[blessed bone shards]] and offered at the [[libation bowl]], or 72 XP when offered with a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]]. [[Virilis]] outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.
*105 XP on average when offered at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]] in the Wilderness. Each offering gives 52.5 XP, which is the same as the gilded altars with two burners lit, but with an additional 50% chance to not consume the bones.

cases.title: Bones (Ape Atoll)
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Bones (Ape Atoll) detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Skeletal gorilla bones''' are dropped by the [[Skeleton (Ape Atoll)|skeletal gorillas]] in the [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]]. Unlike [[Bones|regular bones]], if these are left on the ground for too long, another skeletal gorilla will emerge from them and begin attacking any nearby players. If there are too many skeletal gorillas already spawned, they instead turn into "burning bones", which cannot be picked up. In addition, they cannot be turned into a [[greegree]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
Skeletal gorilla bones give 3 [[Prayer]] experience when buried, unlike standard [[monkey bones]], which give 5 experience. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 9 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
* 9 XP when offered at the [[Sacred Bone Burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 10.5 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit or at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]].
* 12 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[skeleton bonemeal]].

[[File:Superior dragon bones detail.png|left|140px]]
'''Superior dragon bones''' are obtained as a guaranteed drop from killing [[Vorkath]] and as an uncommon drop from killing [[frost dragon]]s. They can be crushed with a [[pestle and mortar]] to create [[crushed superior dragon bones]], which is a secondary ingredient in [[super antifire potion]]s, requiring level 92 [[Herblore]] to create.

Unlike other types of bones, superior dragon bones require a [[Prayer]] level of 70 (unboostable) to use, and give 150 [[Prayer]] experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 450 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
* 450 XP when offered at the [[sacred bone burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 525 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit.
* 600 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[superior dragon bonemeal]].
* 605 XP when [[Blessed superior dragon bones|blessed]] and broken down into [[blessed bone shards]] and offered at the [[libation bowl]], or 726 XP when offered with a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]]. [[Virilis]] outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.
*1050 XP on average when offered at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]] in the Wilderness. Each offering gives 525 XP, which is the same as the gilded altars with two burners lit, but with an additional 50% chance to not consume the bones.

Superior dragon bones provide the most Prayer experience of any bone in the game, but they are very expensive, making them the top-tier choice for efficient training when cost is not a concern. When used at a [[gilded altar]], they require {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Superior dragon bones}}/525}} [[coins]] per experience, while regular [[dragon bones]] use {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dragon bones}}/252}} coins per experience. As such, the most economical use is as a secondary for making [[super antifire potion]]s.

'''Wyrmling bones''' are the [[remains]] obtained from killing [[wyrmling]]s, which give 21 [[Prayer]] experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 
* 63 XP when casting [[Sinister Offering]].
* 63 XP when offered at the [[Sacred Bone Burner]] after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.
* 73.5 XP when offered at a [[gilded altar]] with two burners lit or at the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]]. The Temple additionally has a 50% chance to not deplete the bones; effectively doubling the XP to 147 per bone.
* 105 XP when [[Blessed babywyrm bones|blessed]] and broken down into [[blessed bone shards]] and offered at the [[libation bowl]], or 126 XP when offered with a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]]. [[Virilis]] outside the altar will exchange noted bones for 10 coins each.
* 120 XP when offered at the [[Ectofuntus]] in the form of [[baby dragon bonemeal]].
